is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.s. (page 4, Results section).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (L1014F) and Ace-1 G280S (G119S) (page 4, Methods; Tables 2 and 3).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Tables 2 and 3 provide genotype counts (SS, RS, RR) and allele frequencies for L1014F and Ace-1 mutations across multiple sites.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from six sentinel sites in Côte d’Ivoire (page 2, Study sites).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting new field data collected in 2012.

sub_country_location.evidence: Data is provided for specific localities including Korhogo, Kaforo, Yamoussoukro, Man, Zele, Abengourou, San-Pedro, Bingerville, Port-Bouët, and Yopougon (Table 1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The collection period is explicitly stated as June and July 2012 (page 2, Mosquito collection).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new nation-wide survey conducted in 2012 to generate baseline data for the NMCP.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts and bioassay data are provided in the main text tables (Tables 1-4) and figures (Figures 2-3).

assessment.summary: A nation-wide survey of insecticide resistance in Anopheles gambiae s.s. in Côte d’Ivoire, characterizing resistance phenotypes and genotypes (kdr L1014F and Ace-1 G119S) across six sentinel sites.
